implementation_strategy: Execute full preregistered paired experiment using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the gpt-5-mini hosted endpoint. Use a deterministic, dockerized CPU canonicalizer to convert model text into structured tool-call JSON; run a deterministic rule-engine verifier (schema + syntactic whitelist + signature checks) implemented in CPU-only code. Shared-initial-candidate semantics: one initial model generation per task; guarded condition may trigger at most one repair/generation call per task. All scoring, validation, canonicalization, and hashing are deterministic code executed under the adapter's CPU/docker capabilities. No human adjudication or external private resources.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic selection of 500 confirmatory attack attempts from the synthetic_paired_llm_benchmark_v1 task bank using a published seed. Each selected task is executed as a paired episode (baseline then guarded) under identical input and RNG seeds where available. Benign-safety tasks (for H2) are included as a preregistered disjoint subset drawn from the same public task bank; selection seeds published.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: single initial generation (direct_configuration_generation_v1) → deterministic canonicalizer → deterministic validator scorer (autoscoring). Guarded: use same initial candidate; deterministic verifier applies schema + syntactic whitelist + signature checks; if initial candidate rejected, issue a single guarded repair generation call (generate_validate_repair_v1). All rejection and repair decisions are deterministic and logged.
execution_batches: 10 batches × 50 tasks each (per-batch: 50 tasks × 2 episodes/task = 100 agent runs; 10 batches → 1000 agent runs total). Batches executed sequentially within wall-clock budget.
randomisation_plan: Paired design with deterministic pairing; task selection and batch assignment are pseudo-random but seeded with a published 64-bit seed to ensure reproducibility. No per-condition randomisation; baseline and guarded runs use shared-initial-candidate semantics.
caching_plan: Cache canonicalizer outputs and verifier decisions for identical model-generated text within a run to avoid redundant compute. Cache keys use SHA-256 of model prompt+context; cache stored in dockerized CPU filesystem and published with artifact hashes.
failure_recovery_plan: No retries of model calls (maximum_attempts_per_call=1). If provider/API or infrastructure failure occurs for any run in a pair, the entire pair is excluded deterministically per preregistered missingness_plan and logged with error codes and timestamps. Deterministic sensitivity analyses will treat excluded pairs under preregistered failed_call_treatment options.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (per-episode record: task_id, seed, baseline_success {0,1}, defended_success {0,1}, verifier_flags, canonicalizer_hashes, model_calls_count, latency_ms, raw_model_responses_hashes)
estimated_compute_notes: Arithmetic and budget: 500 preregistered confirmatory tasks × 2 episodes/task = 1,000 agent runs. Adapter semantics: one shared initial generation per task + at most one guarded repair call per task → maximum model calls = 500 × 2 = 1,000. Estimated_model_calls set to worst-case 1,000 (all tasks require repair). This fits the selected adapter's contract and the manifest model-call budget (1,000 ≤ capability_manifest maximum_planned_model_calls 10000). Wall-clock execution planned within 7 days using hosted model API; dockerized CPU canonicalizer and deterministic verifier executed locally in CI containers.
